column1: # tools/symgen_manual.tsv — loader-RE'd symbols (highest priority in symgen.py).  name kind edition va
# Found by aligning build_title_drive's call sequence per edition (2026-11-24): the title menu returns the
# chosen action (28 = Continue), the save list returns 12 with (kind, slot, quest) out-params, the list's
# per-frame runner returns 11 back / 12 confirm / 13 again.  SE runs one of two title menus (a flag picks).
# Sandbox ops (2026-11-24).  room_item_add (thiscall room, id, u16 *idx, count, u8 flag, dry; ret 0x14): SE = the
# call inside item_give (0x404a70 / 0x404ac0 +0x266) — SE caps items per category (+0x2ac >= 900 / +0x78 5..8).
# item_table = the static item-definition table (enold 736 B / SE 940 B per record, +0 id, +4 name, 0-id ends);
# SE item_def also searches item_table_ext (a pointer to 0x200 more records).
# map_module = the HMODULE load_room reads map data from (FindResourceA(mod, room record +0xc, "DATA"); 0 = the exe;
# the area table's +4 after its count overrides it).  load_room 0x586b9c / SE 0x5ad169 / JP 0x5aae39.
# stat_table = the character base-stat table (port: base_stat_table.h, DAT_0067ac58): 0xdc-byte rows {+0 code, +4
# level, +8 hp, +0xc mp, ..., +0x3a display name (the edition's encoding: Japanese on ense-jp), +0x8a English name},
# 0-code row ends; row 0 = {1, 1}.  Found by the names ("Org Archer" row = code 51110); 30 .text references each edition.
# Boot sound-def registrar (stdcall zdd, group, settings; port al_57b280).  SE: with the voice bank loaded it skips
# deluxe_id == 0 rows (core/voice.c patches that je, found by pattern inside this function).
# script_end (2026-11-25): the crosswalk's SE pick (0x4981c0 / 0x498100) is a different function (a story-flag lookup
# on this +0x40ac) — calling it as script_end faulted.  The real one = enold's prologue (51 53 55 56 8b 31 89 4c 24 0c
# 8b 0d .. 33 db 57 3b cb 74 .. 53 6a 32 53 e8), unique per edition.
# g_sys = the engine's system object (sound pools at +0x364, the UI windows): the `this` of every sfx_play call
# (mov ecx, imm32; call sfx_play — 34 / 42 / 41 sites, one constant each edition).  2026-11-25.
# ts_40fe00 (the input latch reset after an event; SE 0x40bee0): JP's crosswalk had none — JP book_read 0x40ba60
# calls it first (same prologue as SE's, sys field offsets shifted +0x120).
# Items (api 1.12).  item_use (thiscall room, pslot, u16 record, char *msg, u16 *lines, 0, dry): SE's use of an
# inventory record on a member (the quick-use / auto-heal path calls it; dry = 1 only asks "would it do anything").
# enold's 0x5b1f10 is the same step with another convention (fastcall) — not bound.
